explanation: The problem varies the promised improvement, the actual worsening, expenses, and pain across three operations. Its baseline includes $20,000 of promised enhancement, $10,000 deterioration, $3,000 pain per operation, and specified doctor and hospital charges. This study link locates the note in the doctrinal discussion; it does not add a holding to the cited authority.
